answer.rationale: Expiry in 14 days plus an 18% spend mandate and a ready low-cost quote create pressure to switch, but 94% utilization with zero buffer means a primary change would raise delivery risk. Inherited record shows benchmarking at renewal moved the incumbent on price and terms (c4) and multi-year volume terms cut unit cost without shrinking scope (c6), while incumbent renewal preserved integration and deliveries (c1). Negotiate using the competing quote as leverage; that is the single action that targets TCO without adding supply risk. Verifying c1/c2 because switch-versus-renew stability is the load-bearing uncertainty.
